title: Story event with salience
description: Something that happens in the story, told at `at`, with its salience (Barthes). Operational rule: a `kernel` is an event the book picks up later (a later paragraph depends on it, refers back to it or follows from it), listed in `picked_up_at`; a `catalysis` is one the book does not pick up. The label describes, it never judges.

text.description: The event as one self-contained sentence in the book's language.

at.description: Paragraph where the event is told (the first telling, if told more than once).

picked_up_at.description: Later paragraphs that pick the event up. Required and non-empty for a kernel; absent for a catalysis. All after `at`.
